## load packages and data

```{r message=F}
rm(list = ls())

library(lavaan) # v.0.6-21
library(pheatmap) # v.1.0.12
library(here) # v.1.0.1

load(here("Analysis_data", "df.Rda"))

```

## CD and Intelligence

```{r}
CD_int_model <- '
## CD model
CD_early =~ NA*E_CD_OE_R + E_CD_OE_S + E_CD_LM_R + E_CD_LM_S
CD_early ~~ 1*CD_early

CD_late =~ NA*L_CD_OE_R + L_CD_OE_S + L_CD_LM_R + L_CD_LM_S
CD_late ~~ 1*CD_late

CD_early ~~ CD_late


## intelligence model
int =~ NA*BIS + equal("int=~BIS")*APM
int ~~ 1*int

BIS =~ NA*PC_Mean + PS_Mean + C_Mean + M_Mean
BIS ~~ 1*BIS

APM =~ NA*PropCorrOdd + equal("APM=~PropCorrOdd")*PropCorrEven
APM ~~ 1*APM


## structural model
int ~ CD_early
int ~ CD_late
'

fit_CD_int <- cfa(CD_int_model, data = df, std.lv = T, 
                      missing = "ML")

summary(fit_CD_int, fit.measures = T, standardized = TRUE)
parameterEstimates(fit_CD_int, level = 0.95, standardized = T, output = "pretty")

zFit <- standardizedSolution(fit_CD_int)
regressions <- subset(zFit, op == "~")
correlations <- subset(zFit, op == "~~")

loadings <- subset(zFit, op == "=~")

```

## heat map of indicators

```{r}
cor_mat <- cor(df[,c(2:9, 15:18 ,20:21)], method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

my_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100)  # Adjust colors as needed
breaks_seq <- seq(-1, 1, length.out = length(my_palette) + 1)

cor_mat[upper.tri(cor_mat)] <- NA
cor_mat <- cor_mat[, ncol(cor_mat):1]

# add reliabilities to diagonal
x <- loadings$est.std^2
x <- x[-c(6,7)]
n <- nrow(cor_mat)
cor_mat[cbind(1:n, n:1)] <- round(x, 2)
cor_mat <- as.data.frame(cor_mat)

num_mat <- round(cor_mat,2)
num_mat[is.na(num_mat)] <- ""

rownames(cor_mat) <- c("E, CD OE-R", "E, CD OE-S", "E, CD LM-R", "E, CD LM-S", "L, CD OE-R", "L, CD OE-S", "L, CD LM-R", "L, CD LM-S", "BIS PC", "BIS PS", "BIS C", "BIS M", "APM Odd", "APM Even")
colnames(cor_mat) <- rev(c("E, CD OE-R", "E, CD OE-S", "E, CD LM-R", "E, CD LM-S", "L, CD OE-R", "L, CD OE-S", "L, CD LM-R", "L, CD LM-S", "BIS PC", "BIS PS", "BIS C", "BIS M", "APM Odd", "APM Even"))

manifest_cors <- pheatmap(cor_mat,    
          cluster_rows = FALSE,  
          cluster_cols = FALSE,
         na_col = "white",
         display_numbers = num_mat,
         #gaps_row = c(10,20),
         #gaps_col = c(10,20),
         border_color = NA,
         angle_col = "315",
         breaks = breaks_seq)

png(here("Figures", "STATS07_heatmap.png"), width = 5.5, height = 4.5, units = "in", res = 600)
print(manifest_cors)
dev.off()
```
